name: ailang-check-on-edit
description: After Claude edits or writes a .ail file, runs `ailang check` from the project root and adds any errors to what the model reads after the tool result, so it sees its own type errors without spending a turn. Works in interactive and headless (claude -p) sessions. Requires the `ailang` binary on PATH.

formatOnEdit.title: Format on edit
formatOnEdit.description: Run `ailang fmt --write` on the file before checking it (rewrites the file Claude just wrote)
